The weighted port throughput calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.70 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weight distribution to ensure the 3m 44s runtime remains efficient.
